Definition: a wavering, i.e. fall; by implication, a pole (as shaking); hence, a yoke (as essentially a bent pole)
BiblicalUsage: 1) a shaking, wavering, pole, bar of yoke; 1a) a shaking, tottering; 1b) pole, bar (for carrying); 1c) bar of yoke
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
